# dsh-meme 0.1.71

Vendored from the installed MIT-licensed dsh-meme by yyh-001:
https://github.com/yyh-001/dsh-meme

The backend, search, animation decoder and optional QQ resize helper are retained.
Local changes: configurable settings file and disposal of the SQLite writer, and indexed ZIP path validation, Beijing dates for exports, and generic example labels in comments.
The Amphoreus adapter captures routes/tools without installing the original
global plugin or its automatic prompt hooks. All character output uses speak.
Built-in and personal image packs are deployment data, copied independently;
they are not included in this source distribution.
